## Security and privacy checklist

*Every box must be genuinely checked. CI scanning does not replace this.*

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, connection strings, or `.env` content
- [ ] No customer, trust, or school names anywhere (code, comments, cells, sample data)
- [ ] No personal data (pupil/staff/parent records), including in test fixtures
- [ ] No subscription IDs, tenant IDs, workspace GUIDs, or internal addresses
- [ ] No internal URLs
- [ ] All notebook outputs stripped (N/A if no notebooks)
